title: Integrate the API with LangChain
excerpt: Wire our OpenAI-compatible endpoint into LangChain agents and chains in minutes.

content.p: LangChain ships with native OpenAI support, so integrating our endpoint is a one-line change: set openai_api_base to our URL.

content.caption: Your LangChain app talking to DaqiAPI

content.p:
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
chat = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini", openai_api_base="https://api.your-domain.com/v1", api_key="sk-your-token")
Tracing keeps working because the requests still look like standard OpenAI calls to the framework.

list: Add a retry policy for transient errors
Cache tool outputs to reduce spend

content.p: Within ten minutes you can have an agent running on our endpoint ⚡.

faq.q: Do I need to change any LangChain code?
faq.a: No. Just set openai_api_base and api_key on the ChatOpenAI and OpenAIEmbeddings instances.

faq.q: Do embeddings work the same way?
faq.a: Yes. OpenAIEmbeddings accepts the same base URL and key, so vector stores work unchanged.

faq.q: Can I use this with LangGraph agents?
faq.a: Yes. Agents built on ChatOpenAI and OpenAI tools run without any extra wiring.

faq.q: Where do I get the api_key?
faq.a: Create a token in the panel and use it as your api_key.
